caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table featuring four slender, slightly curved legs. The tabletop is rectangular with beveled edges and appears to be made of a dark stone or marble, characterized by a pattern of white and gray veining. The wooden frame supporting the tabletop is colored in medium to dark brown tones, with shading that indicates a polished surface. The legs, each with a subtle outward curve and tapering towards small rounded feet, are attached at the corners of the frame. The composition is centered on a neutral, light beige background with faint border lines, and there are some small brownish stains or marks visible towards the left side of the background. The overall perspective of the drawing shows the table at an angle, allowing both the top and two sides to be visible.
title: Sideboard
